caption: The drawing depicts a small, rectangular, ornate metallic box with a hinged lid. The box is rendered in various shades of brown and bronze, with highlights suggesting a metallic sheen. The front panel features a decorative pattern with raised, symmetrical designs, including curving lines and a central flower-like motif. There is a round knob or dial on the left side of the front panel, which has lighter, greenish-brown accents. The sides of the box have a grooved or ridged texture, and the top surface is slightly arched, with additional raised, ornate detailing. The object is centered on a plain, light beige background, and there is a small inscription at the lower right corner of the page with the text "DEL. 390-I RALPH M. BORTON."
title: Iron Bank
